changes.title: Upcoming invoice endpoints replaced by Create Preview Invoice
changes.description: The invoice.GetNext (or invoice.Upcoming) function was removed in API version 2025-03-31.basil. It is replaced by invoice.CreatePreview, which returns the same preview invoice object.

detect.notes: Parameters largely carry over: Customer, Subscription, SubscriptionItems map to the same fields on CreatePreview params; SubscriptionProration* fields moved under SubscriptionDetails in basil.

replace.guidance: Replace invoice.GetNext(params) or invoice.Upcoming(params) with invoice.CreatePreview(params). Replace &stripe.InvoiceUpcomingParams{} with &stripe.InvoiceCreatePreviewParams{}. Move SubscriptionItems and SubscriptionProrationDate under SubscriptionDetails.

changes.title: Subscription CurrentPeriodStart/End moved to subscription items
changes.description: In 2025-03-31.basil, the CurrentPeriodStart and CurrentPeriodEnd fields were removed from the stripe.Subscription struct. Billing periods are now tracked per subscription item.

detect.notes: Only flag reads from a Subscription object; reads already on Items.Data[...] are the NEW pattern and must not be rewritten.

replace.guidance: Replace sub.CurrentPeriodEnd with sub.Items.Data[0].CurrentPeriodEnd for single-item subscriptions. For multi-item subscriptions, iterate Items.Data to find the relevant item's period.

changes.title: stripe.Key global replaced by client.API with per-client keys
changes.description: The global stripe.Key = 'sk_...' pattern and package-level functions like charge.New are deprecated. Use the client.API pattern with per-client keys for thread safety.

detect.notes: The client.API pattern is thread-safe and supports per-request API keys.

replace.guidance: Replace 'stripe.Key = key' + 'charge.New(params)' with 'sc := client.API{Charges: &charge.Client{B: stripe.GetBackend(stripe.APIBackend), Key: key}}' or use the stripe/client package. The per-client pattern allows multiple API keys in the same process.
replace.before:
stripe.Key = os.Getenv("STRIPE_KEY")
c, err := charge.New(&stripe.ChargeParams{Amount: stripe.Int64(1000), Currency: stripe.String("usd")})
